name: IC Sensor — WSON
description: Surface-mount IC sensor cluster utilizing a WSON-12 package footprint with exposed pad and thermal vias.
selection_hints: Select when designing with surface-mount IC sensors in WSON packages.
Verify compatibility with WSON-12-1EP (4x4mm, 0.5mm pitch) thermal via land patterns.
Ensure target application matches available Tier B parts such as LDC1312 or LDC1612.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or non-WSON package footprints are required.
Land patterns without thermal vias or with different exposed pad dimensions are needed.
Tier A verified components or non-sensor ICs are required.
